data.name: Juber
data.gender_notes: Juber is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Juber is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ju' meaning 'God' and 'Ber' meaning 'Gift'. It symbolizes the divine blessing bestowed upon a child, representing the grace and generosity of the gods. The name Juber carries the meaning “God's Gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Juber usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Juber belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juber total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
